evidence.dom: 『Other than us, the following main competitors also hold authorizations to provide PCS with national coverage: Claro S.A., under the bran[d]』→Oi統合後の全国3社寡占。TIM自社シェアは約25%と40%未満だが寡占構造→70
evidence.irr: スペクトラム認可依存だが『main competitors also hold authorizations to provide PCS with national coverage』=3社が同等免許を保有→唯一供給ではなく高摩擦移行困難=70
evidence.rep: 『we became the first and only telecommunications operator covering all municipalities in Brazil with our 4G network』+全州5G。全国網は$10B級・数年では追随不能だが既に3社が構築済→複製不能とまでは言えず極困難=80
evidence.dur: 規制(スペクトラム認可)『for details on spectrum licenses and expiration dates see —Regulation of the Brazilian Telecommunications Industry—Frequencies and Spectrum』+物理網(全国4G/5G・タワー)=100
evidence.erosion: 『Rising competition may increase our churn rate and could continue to adversely affect our market share and margins.』→競争圧力は顕在化しつつあるが実減はなし=emerging
evidence.disrupt: 『These technological developments could broaden consumer choice, alter competitive dynamics and adversely affect our ability to maintain market share, justify investments in fiber capillarity』→技術変化(衛星/FWA/OTT)で競争動学に不確実性=unsettled
evidence.expiry: 『we have started requesting renewals for the same period as the authorizations reach the end of their original term (for details on spectrum licenses and expiration dates ...)』→スペクトラム認可は期限型で更新依存=yes
evidence.geopol: 『Geopolitical, sanitary, financial and sanctions aspects, among others, could cause an interruption of materials and services supply.』+ブラジル一国集中・BRL建て新興国通貨・ANATEL規制依存。ただし顧客分散した全国事業で単一資産集中ではない=1(中)
evidence.moatdecay: 『In 2025, we continued accelerating our nationwide 5G expansion and reached more than 1,000 cities in Brazil』→データ需要・5G拡大で市場成長継続=no
evidence.p1: kenshiフルIC基準ROIC5年(2021-25)σ=3.6pt→<6pt=80。系列は上昇一貫(8.2→18.7)
evidence.p2: COVID時 営利2019:4.5→2020:2.8十億(-38%)=中DD→75。売上は横ばい(17.4→17.3)で通信の防御性を確認。2018年以降のデータ窓内では2015-16ブラジル不況は未観測
evidence.p3: 開示Borrowings基準で純現金(nde-0.13〜-0.06)だがIFRS-16リース負債除外のため実効は軽度プラスの可能性→保守化85
evidence.p4: accr=-16.0%(<0・高現金転換)+material weaknessヒットは監査定型文『concluded that as of December 31, 2025, our internal control over financial reporting was effective and had no material weaknesses』(実指摘ではない)+『Item 4A. Unresolved Staff Comments None.』→90
evidence.f1: ROIC上昇(2023:12.5→2025:18.7%)を安定capex(約4.5十億横ばい)で達成=増分資本の生産性高い。新興国WACC高め(~14%)を考慮しWACC+8pt級で保守化→80
evidence.f2: モバイル浸透は成熟(SIM高浸透)だが『Broadband: Sustainable growth with optionality for the future』『B2B: Accelerating』で隣接に成長余地→≥60%(50)から保守的に+して55(注記:通信の浸透率式は概念的に当てはめ弱い)
evidence.f3: R&D該当薄い業態。シェア趨勢は『shifting focus from absolute market share to revenue share』で絶対シェアは競争圧力・プリペイド減(38.8→35.0%)、収益シェア重視で混在→60
evidence.f4: 『residential broadband business』+IoT『Stellantis expanded its installed base to more than 400,000 connected vehicles』+B2B加速。隣接事業は育成中だが売上5%超の確証乏しい→60
evidence.roicg: 機械算出 2025年: NOPAT ÷ (自己資本 23,977,391,000 + 有利子負債 2,778,723,000)＝のれん込み。roic(除外)との差が買収規律の指標
evidence.roict: 機械算出: のれん除外ROIC 5年系列 13.0% / 10.1% / 14.1% / 16.3% / 22.4%（最古→直近の差で判定）
evidence.gmt: 機械算出: 営業利益率 2023年 19.8% → 2025年 23.8%（±1ptでup/down）
